beats.note: When do you want to start?

copy.caption: Homework the second they walk in? Try a landing first: snack and water, move around, then the first step. And let them pick the start time: “When do you want to start?” Free 5-Minute Homework Start Kit: link in bio.
copy.yt_title: After-School Routine: Give Kids a Landing Before Homework
copy.pin_title: After-School Routine: Snack, Move, Then Start Homework
copy.pin_desc: A simple after-school order for parents of kids 9-13: snack and water, move your body, then the first step. Let your child pick the start time so the start is theirs. Part of the Julia Redmond executive function series for parents. Free 5-Minute Homework Start Kit available from Julia Redmond Publishing.
